description: T1- REAR Garden -Plum(Prunus)-remove outbound limb overhanging boundary wall back to main trunk union-reduce remaining crown to shape and tidyT2 - REAR Garden Lawson's Cypress(Chamcyparis x lawsoniana)-reduce crown heights by 3m to suitable union-trim back remaining side growth to match with emphasis on branches overhanging pavementT3- REAR Garden -Ash(Fraxinus excelsior)-reduce crown by 30%(3.5m) to suitable growth points-reduce lateral branches length to match, shape, and balance with emphasis on branches overhanging pavementOn boundary with neighbouring churchT4 - REAR Garden -Cherry Laurel(Prunus laurosiferus)S1-Firethorn(Pyracantha)-cut back ALL branches overhanging alleyway to boundary to create clear separation from church buildingAll works are for routine maintenance.
